messages:
sophie: Quick design ask — pulled a couple variants for the model catalog filters. Screenshot: https://files.redwood.design/shot123.png

sophie: Option A = compact 'filter shelf' above table (chips + inline counts). Option B = sticky left rail (full labels + collapsible sections). Looking for scannability, keyboard flow, and impact on compare table width. Thoughts?

alex: Option A is denser, nice for power users. Concern: chips overflow on narrow screens and push the compare table horizontally. Need an overflow chip (+3) pattern and an accessible menu for the extras.

alex: Also we should standardize chip focus + aria-pressed semantics. Currently keyboard focus lands on the pill but activation isn't announced.

liam: From infra side, left rail is easier — stable width, compare table virtualization unaffected. But it costs more vertical real estate on mobile.

liam: Badges (perf, latency) are expensive to render per-row. If we keep chips above, we can hide per-row badges behind a column popover or lazy-render them when they enter viewport.

maya: Copy suggestion: replace 'Pin' with 'Lock version' or 'Pin version (session)'. Users didn't understand persistence. Maybe add a tooltip: "Pinned versions persist for this route until you unpin".

dena: Usability test notes — users misinterpreted badge colors: red/orange/green looked like severity not performance tiers. Add an explicit legend and aria-labels: "Performance: High" etc.

jordan: Proposed microinteraction: when you pin a version, don't shift the table. Use an overlay indicator in the row header instead of inserting a cell.

jordan: Quick CSS idea:

```
.chip[aria-pressed="true"] { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(83,110,236,0.25); }
.catalog-compare__rows { will-change: transform; }
[role="listbox"] { max-height: 48vh; overflow:auto; }
```

alex: Accessibility nit: ensure chips have role="button" or role="option" depending on grouping, and provide aria-multiselectable if multiple chips can be active.

liam: Keyboard shortcuts proposal: `/` to focus filter shelf, `p` to toggle pin on focused row. Need accessibility review but +1 from infra for the handlers.

ui-bot: Screenshot diff uploaded — https://files.redwood.design/diff/shot123-v2.png :eyes:

sophie: Action items — (1) alex to update prototype with overflow menu + legend (2) jordan to mock pinned-overlay (3) liam to prototype lazy render for badges (4) maya to finalise copy for pin tooltip. Checkpoints by EOD Tue. :white_check_mark:

dena: I'll pull a quick 5-person hallway test on Tuesday morning to validate chip discoverability.

maya: Thanks everyone. If no blockers I'll schedule a short review Wednesday 11am. :calendar:
